## HueMux v0.0.4-alpha.16 — On/off border tint on light cards

> **Alpha.** Light cards now read their on/off state from the border: an ON
> light carries a faint wash of its own color around the card (like a preset
> pill) with the 6px strip at full strength, an OFF light goes grey all round
> — the color button still shows the selected hue either way.

The room-tile button order and the borderless treatment shipped in alpha.15;
this release layers the state tint on top.
